Subject: Runway unblock: Q3 tactical steer + action register

Team — quick mid-quarter pulse and a compact ask list so leadership has a view going into QBR prep. I pulled a short action register (attached) combining critical dependency asks, estimated effort, and owner. Highlights: 

- Metrics: we are ~58% to the Q target on Hosted API latency SLO (p90) and ~46% on Dedicated throughput ramp. Cost/unit is slightly higher than target for embedding workloads due to memory+IO footfall.
- Top 3 blockers we need to surface to execs: 1) Acme Analytics compliance evidence needed to sign the Dedicated pilot (SOC2 items); 2) Network egress policy for EU pilot causing staging flakiness; 3) Model quantization validation backlog on 2.4B variants.

Asks: 
1) Laura — consolidating legal/procurement timeline for Acme (dates/contacts). Can you confirm by EOD?
2) Aditya — can infra commit to a 2-week focused slot for quant validation engineers starting next Mon? We only need an initial smoke validation to allow canary rollouts.
3) Marissa — please align CS to a single mutual-action-plan (MAP) entry for the Acme pilot so we can avoid repeated asks.

I attached a small catalog (runway-unblock-catalog.xlsx) with owners and rough ETA. I want us to enter QBR with a clear mitigation plan rather than a laundry list. If external teams (Samir/procurement) can confirm timing, we can promise a targeted pilot start window.

Thanks — Karthik

--

Karthik — thanks for the clear register. Quick updates from my side: 

- Legal has requested the SOC2 evidence pack from Acme to enable the pilot contract. I put a procurement contact in the tracker but don't have a concrete date from Acme yet.
- I'll need a short list of the exact evidence items they must provide (scope: infra vs app) so legal doesn't go back and forth. Samir, can you confirm whether Acme can produce the infra-level artifacts (network diagrams, SOC2 subservice carve-outs) or do we need to accept higher-level attestations?

Action: I'll follow up with procurement and confirm timeline by EOD tomorrow (Thu). If Samir can send the SOC2-evidence-ask.pdf referenced in your note, that would speed things up.

- One ask to Aditya: if infra can only spare a single 2-week slot, can we prioritize the quant validation for generator endpoints first (those affect latency SLOs directly)?

Laura

- We can produce the SOC2 artifacts you listed, but timeline is dependent on our security team's review calendar. I attached the initial ask list (SOC2-evidence-ask.pdf) — it outlines infra and app sections. We estimate we can hand over the infra artifacts in ~6 business days, app artifacts may take 10-12 business days.
- Procurement (cc'd) — please route contract redline questions to me; we can fast-track an addendum for the pilot.
